notes.en: [[character:xinyan]]'s [[element:pyro]] DPS playstyle requires [[character:bennett]]'s [C6] to function. With [[element:pyro]] infused attack [[character:xinyan]] can take advantage of varyious elemental damage supports, such as [[character:kaedehara-kazuha]] and [[character:chevreuse]].
notes.ru: [[character:xinyan]] в качестве [[element:pyro]] ДД требует C6 [[character:bennett|Беннета]]. Благодаря [[eleemnt:pyro]] инфузии, [[character:xinyan]] cможет использовать усиления элементального урона от таких персонажей, как [[character:kaedehara-kazuha]] и [[character:chevreuse]].

notes.en: **Pre-C6 combo: **{rot:2N4D N2}**. At C6 it's preferable to do one full [[abilities:ca]] cycle followed by **{rot:N2}**.
